note: Readings that mapping runs replaced, retired from every list of the map, never deleted: each stays in the store and its flower still opens by its hash; its map shows the reading that replaced it. Taking its line out brings it back. Each says what changed. Claims a mapping run reissued are retired the same way (claims): no map's list of the mapping's claims shows them, and search leaves them out.
decided: Shared map curation, 11 Nov 2026: map identity repairs on Gnosis, Ethereum, Arbitrum and Base; 12 Nov 2026: the NEAR and Solana repairs, and the 1-day holder windows of 9 Nov read again whole; 14 Nov 2026: 43 claims a mapping run kept under a NEAR config binding its source did not declare, withheld from publishing
